args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollback succeeded (`status: rolled_out`).
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — created successfully (the initial call timed out, but verification confirmed the incident was opened).

**Post-rollback verification:**
- checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: the rollback to v2.3.0 was to a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
